_description: Preliminary progressive-stamping DFM heuristics. These are not universal ISO limits. The stamper must confirm all limits for the material, thickness, press, tooling, and operation sequence. Unknown data -> NEEDS_CLARIFICATION.

_sources.engineering_review: General design guidance; company/stamper approval required

rules.message: Carrier/bridge width is below the preliminary 1.5×t guideline; check strip stiffness, material, and station loads.
Pilot-hole diameter is very small relative to thickness; check pilot strength, positioning accuracy, and wear.
Forming radius is below 1×t; assess material grade, hardness, rolling direction, and cracking risk.
Burr height exceeds the specified company/supplier limit.
Confirm that the part remains attached to the carrier until the intended cut-off operation.
Scrap slug ejection has not been verified; assess the risks of slug pulling and slug stacking.
